title: Past-to-future Poincaré inequality for arbitrary hypoelliptic commutator chains
author: Francesca Anceschi; Helge Dietert; Jessica Guerand; Amélie Loher; Clément Mouhot; Annalaura Rebucci
work: Poincaré inequality and quantitative De Giorgi method for hypoelliptic operators
difficulty_reason: After the ordinary weak-subsolution and De Giorgi prerequisites, the authors construct explicit controlled trajectories for an arbitrary Kolmogorov commutator chain and prove invertibility of their Wronskian/control matrices. They obtain quantitative estimates for endpoint maps, Jacobians and inverse derivatives, then integrate along those trajectories to transfer diffusion control into a genuine past-to-future Poincare bound, treating both local and fractional operators. The choice of trajectory exponents and the associated change-of-variable/integrability estimates are nonroutine source-local obligations beyond ordinary doctoral qualifying-exam PDE theory.
